MlxTargets.TargetFields: arch os abi endian pointer_bits cpu_features
MlxTargets.BuiltinModule: target, cpu features, optimize mode, language version

Target.output: ELF shared object for the output path ending in .so, signed APK for .apk

MlxTargets.Rule: A function requiring a CPU feature may only be called when the compilation target guarantees the feature or from code guarded by an explicit runtime dispatch mechanism that targets a feature-specialized function.
